service.name: Camera_RenderTerrainViewport
behavior: Selects terrain rows from TERRAIN_ROW_POINTER_TABLE using CAMERA_REFERENCE_Y and starts at the camera-aligned X word.
Uses VDP_TILE_ROW_COMMAND_TABLE to emit four tile words per map word through VDP_DATA.
Indexes LEVEL_BACKGROUND_BLOCK_SOURCE with each terrain map word to obtain the emitted tile words.

conclusion: The former anonymous camera helper is the special-mode visible terrain viewport renderer. Its 16-by-23 geometry and active resource inputs are now explicit; the higher-level visual meaning of individual terrain blocks remains in the level asset model.
